This clinic feels like visiting a café in a rose garden — great atmosphere and clean rooms.
The doctor is a graduate in Thai traditional medicine and used to be a professor at Mae Fah Luang University. Today I came for a neck and shoulder massage with herbal compress, which effectively relieved my office syndrome symptoms.
Highly recommended for anyone experiencing muscle pain or tension. The clinic also offers deep tissue massage, trigger finger massage, and traditional postpartum care with herbal heat therapy.
